verdict: Paid channels are off; organic visibility is the only signal and it's softening.
narrative: There was no paid activity on Meta or Google this period — zero spend, zero leads. Your Google Business Profile was the only active channel, delivering 40 total actions (calls, direction requests, and website clicks) from 371 impressions over 28 days. That signal weakened sharply in the last 7 days, with GBP actions dropping 75% versus the prior week and the last three days logging no actions at all, consistent with reduced search visibility. Website sessions held relatively steady at roughly 6–7 per day, suggesting some direct or referral traffic is still arriving; ad campaigns are being reactivated to rebuild lead flow.
